//: Source of truth for composed agent context. See adrs/0018-composing-agent-context-per-surface.md.
//fragments: Fragments are authored standalone with their own H1. The generator demotes every heading one level and emits a single H1 per output, so composed files satisfy MD025.
//outputs: Output paths differ by delivery route, deliberately: the workstation profile writes to home/, which chezmoi deploys unchanged; other profiles write to profiles/, which is repo-meta and is fetched by cloud/bootstrap.sh.
//skills: Skill bodies compose the same way, one tier down (#265). A fragment is one section of the skill; a section whose content differs by surface has a -workstation and a -sandbox variant, and every output names exactly one of the pair. The first fragment is the head: head-skill carries the frontmatter and the H1. There used to be a head-command beside it, carrying the one-line description a home/commands/ twin needs instead of frontmatter; the twins were retired (#313) and it went with them. Both cloud profiles take the same sandbox fragments — what varies for these skills is the environment (no usable gh), not the provider.

retrospective.//: Two variant pairs out of 15 sections (#288). Eight sites in the original branched on `command -v chezmoi`; six of them failed ADR-0018 principle 8's questions and were reworded or deleted instead. 07-propose is the lever table, whose cells are genuinely false on the other surface. 08-route is the durable-lesson route, where a memory file persists on a workstation and evaporates in a container. The other six either keyed on whether a paul-context clone is reachable — which is not a surface fact, see #289 — or restated a decision step 6 already makes.

end-session.//: Ten variant pairs out of 22 sections — the highest ratio of the three, and the reason is real rather than lazy: this skill acts on local state, and local state is exactly what a disposable container makes meaningless. Steps 6 and 12 do no work on a sandbox (#283), step 11 has no chezmoi to check, and the GitHub steps take a different route entirely (#265). Composed before ADR-0018 principle 8 existed, so its pairs have not been re-examined under the two questions; #283 added one (18-worktrees) that was checked against them.
